name: platform_overview
description: Platform-wide snapshot: live/funded/total campaigns, money raised and backers in the last 30 days and all time, new accounts, and the top categories. Start here for any 'how are we doing' question.

name: list_projects
description: List campaigns with live funding stats. Filter by status, category, creator email or a title search. Use this to find a campaign's slug before calling get_project or project_backers.

status.description: Only these statuses. Default: LIVE and FUNDED.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on title or subtitle.

name: get_project
description: Everything about one campaign: funding, dates, creator, reward tiers and add-ons with claimed counts, pledge status breakdown, update count, and a daily funding timeline. Pass the slug from the campaign URL.

project.description: Project slug (as in the campaign URL) or project id.

timelineDays.description: Days of daily pledge history to include (0 to skip).

name: project_backers
description: Backers of one campaign with what they pledged: name, email, amount, reward, add-ons, country, survey and fulfillment state. Addresses are only included when includeAddress is true. Returns CSV when format is csv.

project.description: Project slug (as in the campaign URL) or project id.

status.description: Pledge statuses to include. Default COMPLETED only.

includeAddress.description: Include the shipping address from the survey.

name: campaign_performance
description: Money raised per campaign in a date window, with pledge count, unique backers, average pledge and refunds. Use for 'what did well this month' and comparisons between campaigns.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date or datetime. Defaults to 30 days ago.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

name: category_breakdown
description: Campaigns launched, money raised and pledges per category in a date window. Good for deciding where outreach should focus.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date or datetime. Defaults to 30 days ago.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

name: project_updates
description: A campaign's posted updates: title, status, publish date, likes and comment counts. Tells you how actively a creator is communicating with backers.

project.description: Project slug (as in the campaign URL) or project id.

name: find_user
description: Look up accounts by exact email or a name/email search. Returns role, join date, pledge count and total, campaigns created, and whether they've unsubscribed. Use user_pledges or user_email_history for the detail.

search.description: Partial match on name or email.

name: user_pledges
description: Every pledge by one backer, with campaign, amount, status, reward, survey and fulfillment state. Newest first.

name: backer_segments
description: Build an outreach list of backers. Segments: lapsed (haven't pledged in N days), repeat (at least N completed pledges), top_spenders, category_fans (backed campaigns in a category), project_backers (backed one campaign), creator_backers (backed any campaign by a creator), new_backers (first pledge within N days). Unsubscribed and deleted accounts are excluded unless includeUnsubscribed is true. Returns email, name, pledge count, total, last pledge and categories; CSV when format is csv.

minPledges.description: Threshold for repeat; minimum for every other segment is 1.

name: creator_pipeline
description: Creators by where their campaign is stuck: drafts (started but never submitted), submitted (waiting on review), approved_not_launched, live, ended, or never_created (CREATOR role with no campaign at all). For nudging creators toward launch.

inactiveDays.description: Only include campaigns not touched for at least this many days.

name: email_engagement
description: Sent / opened / clicked counts for platform email in a date window, grouped by recipient domain, email type, or day. Opens are tracked on marketing mail only, so transactional types show opens as null. Use it to spot a mailbox provider that stopped delivering.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date or datetime. Defaults to 30 days ago.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

minSent.description: Hide groups with fewer sends than this.

name: user_email_history
description: What we've sent one person and what became of it: transactional/marketing log with open times, plus the Sent-folder copies with the mail provider's delivery verdict (delivered, bounced, not delivered) and reason. Also reports blocklist and unsubscribe state. First stop for 'they say they never got the email'.

name: email_campaigns
description: Marketing email campaigns with their send stats: recipients, sent, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes and attributed pledges.

name: newsletter_stats
description: Newsletter list size, active vs unsubscribed, growth over the last 30/90 days, and subscribers by source and tag.

name: email_deliverability
description: Can we email this address? Checks the blocklist, site-wide unsubscribe, newsletter status and the last provider verdict for the address.

name: sentinel_errors
description: Error groups from Sentinel (the built-in error tracker): title, level, source, counts, first/last seen. Default: unresolved errors seen in the last 24 hours.

hours.description: Only groups last seen within this many hours.

search.description: Substring match on the error title.

name: sentinel_error_detail
description: Full detail for one Sentinel error group: latest message, stack trace, metadata and the most recent occurrences with URL, method, status and user.

name: search_logs
description: Search the application's pm2 logs for a literal string (a pledge id, user id, email, correlationId, or message text) and return the most recent matching lines. Each line is a JSON log entry. Use it to trace what happened to one pledge or request.

query.description: Literal text to look for (not a regex).

lines.description: Most recent matching lines to return.

name: agent_call_log
description: Recent calls made through this Agent API (by any key): tool, outcome, duration. Useful to see what an earlier session already asked for.

name: extend_campaign
description: Push a live or funded campaign's end date out by N days. Refuses campaigns that are FAILED or CANCELLED, since refunds or wind-down have already run on those.

project.description: Project slug (as in the campaign URL) or project id.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the change.

name: set_campaign_goal
description: Change a campaign's funding goal. Lowering a goal below the amount already raised makes the campaign show as funded immediately.

project.description: Project slug (as in the campaign URL) or project id.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the change.

name: add_newsletter_subscribers
description: Import or re-activate newsletter subscribers in bulk, e.g. a Shopify or eBay customer export. Pass `subscribers` as objects with email and optional name and per-row tags (up to 5000 per call), or `emails` as bare strings. `tags` applies to every row; `source` labels where they came from (shopify, ebay, csv…). Existing subscribers get the new tags merged and a missing name filled in. Addresses on the blocklist, accounts that unsubscribed site-wide, and anyone who unsubscribed from the newsletter are skipped and listed in the result, never added.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the change.

name: reverse_backer_chargebacks
description: For a backer whose disputes were withdrawn or won by the platform: refund every creator who was charged a chargeback recoup (disputed amount + dispute fee) for that backer's pledges, and waive any still uncollected. Optionally restore the pledges from CHARGEBACK to COMPLETED when the money stayed with the campaign. Run with dryRun first; it lists each creator and amount. This also runs automatically when an admin unbans the backer.

restorePledges.description: Also reinstate their CHARGEBACK pledges. Only when the disputes were withdrawn and the money stayed.

reason.default: Disputes resolved in the backer's favour

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the change.

name: create_email_campaign_draft
description: Create a marketing email campaign as a DRAFT in Admin → Email. It is never sent by this tool: an admin reviews and sends it from the dashboard. targetAudience is a free label the admin picks from in the UI (e.g. all, backers, creators).

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the change.

name: match_emails
description: Compare a list of email addresses (e.g. Shopify or eBay customers) against IndieCrowdfund. For each address: is there an account, have they backed anything (count/total/last), are they on the newsletter, unsubscribed, or blocklisted. Use include to get just the people who have never backed a campaign — the outreach list. Up to 5000 addresses per call; CSV available.

name: create_email_campaign
description: Create a marketing email campaign in Admin → Email. mode 'ai' writes it with the platform's AI from a name, hint and intro, featuring live campaigns (optionally the slugs you choose) as cards; mode 'html' uses your own HTML, wrapped in the branded shell unless it is already a full email. Audience: subscriber (newsletter + verified users), backer, creator, retailer, or all. segmentTags narrows subscriber/all to newsletter subscribers carrying those tags — tag an outreach list with add_newsletter_subscribers first, then target the tag. Created as DRAFT (or SCHEDULED when scheduleFor is set); nothing is sent until send_email_campaign.

subjectHint.description: ai mode: subject line idea the AI should work from.

introMessage.description: ai mode: what the email should say, in your words; the AI polishes it.

projectCategory.description: ai mode: only feature live campaigns in this category.

projectSlugs.description: ai mode: feature exactly these campaigns (slugs).

html.description: html mode: body or full email HTML. [[campaign:slug]] tokens become campaign cards.

scheduleFor.description: ISO datetime to send automatically; omit to leave as a draft.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: preview_email_campaign
description: Inspect a campaign before sending: subject, status, audience, live recipient count, stats so far, a text rendering of the body, and optionally the full HTML.

name: send_email_campaign
description: Send a campaign. With testTo, sends ONE copy to that address with a [TEST] subject and changes nothing else — do this first. Without testTo, queues the email to the whole audience (1/second from the queue) and marks the campaign SENT. resend allows sending a SENT campaign again. Always confirm the recipient count with the user before a real send.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: run_ai_service
description: Run one of the built-in AI marketing services now, exactly as the Run Now buttons in Admin → AI Marketing do. runAutomation = the daily orchestrator (profiles, segments, plans and SENDS one campaign if eligible). runSegmentation, runPredictiveAnalytics, runSendTimeOptimization, runUserProfiling recompute scores. runAutoTagging tags untagged campaigns. The test* actions produce a sample without sending. Disabled services refuse with a message; enable them with update_ai_settings.

params.description: Optional per-action params, e.g. { limit: 20 } for runAutoTagging, { content, contentType } for testContentOptimization.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: ai_status
description: Current state of the built-in AI marketing: feature toggles, limits, quiet hours, the standing directives, the last automated campaign and recent automated-campaign performance.

name: ai_run_history
description: History of AI service runs (manual, cron and agent-triggered): service, success, summary message, duration.

name: update_ai_settings
description: Turn AI marketing features on or off and set the volume limits. Only the fields you pass change. Takes effect within a minute (settings are cached per worker).

emailFrequencyCap.description: Max marketing emails per person per 14 days.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: get_marketing_directives
description: The standing plain-English instructions the marketing AI follows when it writes campaign emails, the creator newsletter, social posts and marketing copy.

name: set_marketing_directives
description: Give the marketing AI standing instructions in plain English, e.g. 'This month lead with the Tech category', 'Always mention our Shopify store at indiecrowdfund.com/shop', 'No exclamation marks'. They are injected into every marketing prompt from then on. mode replace overwrites; append adds a line. Max 4000 characters.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: smart_segments
description: The AI's behaviour-based user segments (at-risk churners, high-value, new, dormant…) with sizes and characteristics. Computed live; takes a few seconds.

name: generate_marketing_copy
description: Have the platform AI write marketing copy for one campaign: tagline, subtitle, email subject, X/Facebook/Instagram posts and a call to action. Nothing is published; it returns text for you to use.

name: social_posts
description: The AI publicist's queue for X: pending (awaiting approval), posted, failed and rejected posts with their text and the campaign they promote.

name: create_social_post
description: Queue a hand-written post for the platform's X account. It waits as PENDING in Admin → Social Publicist until an admin approves it or you call publish_social_post. Keep under 280 characters including any URL.

project.description: Slug or id of the campaign this promotes, if any.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: publish_social_post
description: Post a queued (PENDING or APPROVED) social post to X right now. Irreversible once posted.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: generate_social_posts
description: Run the AI publicist's generation pass: find launches, milestones, ending-soon campaigns and the weekly roundup, write posts for them and queue them (respecting the approval setting). Idempotent.

confirm.description: Must be true. Send only after the user has approved the action.

name: run_sql
description: Run a read-only SQL query (SELECT / WITH / EXPLAIN) against the production Postgres database and get the rows back. One statement, 15-second timeout, up to 500 rows. Table and column names are quoted CamelCase as in the Prisma schema, e.g. SELECT title, "goalAmount" FROM "Project" WHERE status = 'LIVE'. Columns holding passwords, hashes, tokens, card or bank data are refused. Prefer the purpose-built tools when one fits; use this for questions they don't cover.

name: server_status
description: Health snapshot of the IndieCrowdfund server: app workers (pm2), memory and disk, uptime, database reachability, email queue depth, and the last cron and AI runs.
